actors.label: Structure manager
actors.context: Authenticated administrator responsible for models and public navigation

actors.label: Business modeler
actors.context: Authenticated administrator responsible for entity definitions

actors.label: Schema operator
actors.context: Authenticated administrator planning and executing relational changes

actors.label: Business operator
actors.context: Authenticated administrator operating policy-filtered business records

actors.label: Report operator
actors.context: Authenticated administrator or portal member with report authority

actors.label: Security administrator
actors.context: Authenticated administrator governing users, scope, policies and credentials

actors.label: System administrator
actors.context: Authenticated administrator responsible for configuration and platform lifecycle

actors.label: Portal approver
actors.context: Authenticated portal member with scoped maker-checker authority

actors.label: Extension surface operator
actors.context: Authorized actor using a trusted extension-owned graphical contribution

actors.label: Template author

must_not_receive: Permission to remove mandatory safety semantics

tasks.label: Read managed public content
tasks.primary_outcome: The visitor reaches the canonical published page and understands where to go next.

tasks.label: Sign in to the administrator
tasks.primary_outcome: A valid administrator obtains only an administrator session and reaches an intentional landing page.

tasks.label: Orient in the administrator
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor sees relevant activity and one clear route into current work.

tasks.label: Find and select content
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor filters a collection and opens the intended content record.

tasks.label: Create, edit and publish content
tasks.primary_outcome: A validated content record progresses through its authorized workflow without lost edits.

tasks.label: Manage media
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor uploads, identifies and safely removes an authorized media item.

tasks.label: Manage content models
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor understands and changes fields, presentation and workflow as coherent concerns.

tasks.label: Manage public navigation
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor maintains a valid, understandable menu tree and canonical target paths.

tasks.label: Model and publish a business definition
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor can locate, inspect, edit, validate, publish and review one definition without losing context.

tasks.label: Plan, approve, execute and recover schema work
tasks.primary_outcome: A version-bound plan advances only with the required approval and recovery evidence.

tasks.label: Discover an authorized business workspace
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor finds an allowed entity workspace without learning denied entity names or counts.

tasks.label: Operate a business record
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor browses, reads, creates, edits, reviews history and performs allowed actions consistently.

tasks.label: Manage business relationships and choices
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor selects only authorized related records and updates the intended relationship.

tasks.label: Use a contributed business view
tasks.primary_outcome: A typed contributed view appears in standard context and retains policy-filtered actions.

tasks.label: Monitor a long-running business operation
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor understands status, last update, safe navigation and recovery or retry disposition.

tasks.label: Run a report and retrieve an export
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor selects a report, supplies parameters, understands results and retrieves only an authorized artifact.

tasks.label: Manage users, roles, grants, assignments and tokens
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor changes one identity concern at a time with explicit scope, impact and audit attribution.

tasks.label: Govern organizations, memberships, policy and approvals
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor can separate authority tasks, preserve scope and explain effective access.

tasks.label: Install, inspect, activate, disable and recover an extension
tasks.primary_outcome: Only trusted active contributions execute and owned data survives lifecycle changes.

tasks.label: Configure site and presentation settings
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor changes a coherent settings group with explicit dirty, validation and saved state.

tasks.label: Manage jobs, schedules, runs and failures
tasks.primary_outcome: The actor can configure work and distinguish scheduled, running, failed and recoverable states.

tasks.label: Sign in to the portal
tasks.primary_outcome: A valid scoped member reaches the portal without receiving administrator authority.

tasks.label: Orient in ordinary portal work
tasks.primary_outcome: The member sees plain-language permitted work, approvals, reports and account destinations.

tasks.label: Manage portal account assurance
tasks.primary_outcome: The member enrolls or uses step-up and recovery controls without exposing secrets after issuance.

tasks.label: Review and decide an approval
tasks.primary_outcome: The approver understands scope and impact and submits a version-bound, non-replayable decision.

tasks.label: Use a trusted extension-owned surface
tasks.primary_outcome: The extension task uses the core shell, capability, trust, template isolation and KIS contract.

tasks.label: Build or activate a conforming installable template
tasks.primary_outcome: Approved appearance and composition change globally while semantics, security, accessibility and recovery remain intact.

journeys.label: Discover and read managed public content
journeys.success: The visitor follows managed navigation to a canonical published page at desktop or mobile width.

journeys.label: Administrator entry and orientation
journeys.success: Authentication, session isolation, capability-filtered navigation and a clear next action are intact.

journeys.label: Create, publish and find managed content
journeys.success: The authorized actor creates valid content, uses media, progresses state and verifies canonical public output.

journeys.label: Model content and connect it to public navigation
journeys.success: Model and navigation changes remain valid, version-aware and understandable in public presentation.

journeys.label: Define an entity and make its storage ready
journeys.success: A validated published definition receives an approved portable schema and an authorized generated workspace.

journeys.label: Operate, relate and review a business record
journeys.success: Browse, create, update, relation, action, history and long-running status preserve one policy and concurrency contract.

journeys.label: Run an authorized report and retrieve its export
journeys.success: Parameters, policy-filtered results, immutable export status and authorized download remain comprehensible.

journeys.label: Establish scope, policy and maker-checker control
journeys.success: Identity, membership, policy, effective access and approval remain scoped, attributable and non-replayable.

journeys.label: Provision an ordinary portal member
journeys.success: A deliberately provisioned member can sign in and sees exactly the authorized workspace without administrator access.

journeys.label: Complete ordinary portal work
journeys.success: The member can discover work, operate allowed records, report, decide approvals and manage assurance using ordinary vocabulary.

journeys.label: Install, use, disable and restore graphical contributions
journeys.success: Trusted contributions appear with correct navigation and policy, disappear on disable, recover on reactivation and retain owned data.

journeys.label: Configure and observe durable automation
journeys.success: Jobs, schedules, runs and failures have distinct states and safe recovery controls.

journeys.label: Install, customize, upgrade and reset presentation
journeys.success: An installed template changes approved tokens and slots, survives upgrade or falls back safely, and can be reset to KIS defaults.
